pack.pack_markdown:
# Pocket Canal Keeper — Interaction Wireframe Pack v0.2
Core: Canal Board. Portrait fixed oblique board with the whole canal graph readable while devices are manipulated. Six inventory surfaces are represented: Stage Select, Stage Brief, Canal Board, Boat Inspect Popover, Pause Overlay, Stage Result. Core controls are gate arc drag, bridge circular drag, lock vertical drag, signal tap and boat inspect. Protected-segment occupancy is atomic and unsafe commands are rejected before state corruption. Device Busy is a board variant, not a new screen; independent devices remain usable. Warning highlights only the affected protected zone. Boat inspection is non-destructive and simulation continues. Godot ownership: AppRoot progression, CanalSimulation graph/boats/devices/timers, UI presentation. Six data-driven stages and complete retry/next/unlock loop are required.

global_ui_rules.board_rule: protected segments, boats and device states must remain simultaneously readable

hints: reserve protected segment before movement animation
unsafe lock command is rejected, not partially applied
no free steering or rigid-body water

acceptance_criteria: All six inventory surfaces exist and are reachable
Gate arc drag, bridge circular drag, lock vertical drag, signal tap and boat inspect each connect to explicit components and state changes
Protected narrow segment never visually contains two boats; reservation is atomic
Occupied bridge rotation and unsafe lock sequence are rejected with feedback and no state corruption
Device busy locks only that device while independent controls remain usable
Pause freezes boat movement, device animation and timeout timers
Three strikes or a 45-second boat timeout reaches failure Result
All boats delivered reaches success Result and computes stars from success/no-strike/par operations
Six data stages can be played/retried sequentially and occupancy/devices reset cleanly

design.design_markdown:
# Pocket Canal Keeper — Playable Game Design Spec v0.1

## 1. Product Definition
Portrait mobile traffic puzzle/management. 6~10분 세션. 미니어처 운하의 물리 장치를 직접 조작해 배 흐름을 안전하게 푼다. Non-goals: 자유 물리, 도시건설, 경제.
## 2. Player Fantasy
작은 수상도시의 수문지기. 네트워크와 장치 순서를 읽어 막힘을 푸는 관제 숙련감.
## 3. Core Player Verbs
Gate arc drag, bridge circular drag, lock vertical drag, signal tap, boat inspect.
## 4. Core Loop
흐름 관찰 → 목적지/trait 확인 → 장치 조작 → 구간 진입 관찰 → 충돌/막힘 예측 → 순서 수정 → 전원 도착.
## 5. Round / Session Structure
2~4분 stage, 3~6 boats. 2~3 stages가 한 세션. Result에서 Retry/Next.
## 6. Game Rules
Segment graph 기반 deterministic 이동. narrow protected segment는 한 배만 점유. unsafe command는 strike/reject. 3 strikes 또는 45s timeout 실패. 성공/no-strike/par-ops 3-star.
## 7. State Model
stage_brief, running, device_busy, warning, paused, result.
## 8. Interaction Spec
Lever arc drag, wheel circular drag, lock vertical drag, buoy tap, boat tap. hit-test, snap/cancel, interlock rejection 포함.
## 9. Content Model
Stage 데이터 = canal graph, devices, spawn schedule, boat traits/destinations, water bands, constraints, par. MVP 6개.
## 10. Difficulty / Variation
단일 수문 → 회전교/양방향 → lock/trait/priority. 속도가 아니라 의존성과 순서로 난도 상승.
## 11. Progression
6 stages 순차 unlock. 별은 숙련 목표.
## 12. Economy
Not required.
## 13. Screen Inventory
Stage Select, Stage Brief, Canal Board, Boat Inspect Popover, Pause Overlay, Stage Result.
## 14. Screen Flow
Select → Brief → Board ↔ Busy/Warning/Inspect → Result → Retry/Next.
## 15. Feedback System
Gate/water arrows, gear/bridge state, water gauge, red protected zone, dock pulse, device sounds/haptics.
## 16. Visual Direction Brief
Portrait fixed oblique tabletop canal. 전체 graph와 boats 동시 판독, device handles 44dp 이상, 최소 HUD.
## 17. MVP Scope
6 stages, graph movement, four device interactions, occupancy/safety, inspect, result/stars, full replay loop.
## 18. Test Scenarios
Gate-only Stage1, shared-segment safety, occupied bridge interlock, unsafe lock rejection, replay reset.
## 19. Known Risks
small-screen overlap, rule overload, over-automation, graph deadlock/state sync.
## 20. Wireframe Handoff
Canal graph/protected zones, all gesture hit areas, busy/warning/paused/result variants, inspect/path, invalid/collision/timeout/success transitions를 반드시 표현한다.
design.round_structure: 스테이지 2~4분. Brief 후 3~6척이 순차 spawn. 모든 배 도착 시 성공. 3 safety strikes 또는 한 배 45초 timeout 시 실패. Result에서 Retry/Next. 세션 2~3 stages, 6~10분.
wireframe_handoff: 전체 canal graph와 protected segment/occupancy 표현

design.primary_interaction: 수문 레버를 끌고 회전교를 돌리고 lock 수위를 조절해 공유 운하 구간의 배 흐름을 직접 관제한다.
design.difficulty_variation: 초반은 수문 하나와 단일 교차 흐름으로 점유 규칙을 익힌다. 중반은 회전교와 양방향 대기열로 상호배타 상태를 추가한다. 후반은 lock 수위, 큰 배/낮은 다리 trait, spawn 순서와 priority를 결합한다. 속도가 아니라 네트워크 의존성과 장치 순서가 난도를 만든다.
design.visual_direction_brief: Portrait, fixed oblique top-down tabletop canal board. 전체 네트워크와 3~6척의 배를 동시에 읽을 수 있어야 하며 장치 손잡이는 실제 운하보다 과장해 최소 44dp hit area를 확보한다. 물/육지/보호 구간/배 경로를 명확히 분리하고 UI는 가장자리의 최소 HUD로 유지한다.
